newsitem.title: GERMANY: Henkel takes rest of stake in Schwarzkopf.
newsitem.headline: Henkel takes rest of stake in Schwarzkopf.

text.p: German specialty chemicals group Henkel KGaA said on Thursday that it plans to acquire the remaining 23 percent of consumer products group Hans Schwarzkopf that it does not already own.

Henkel, best known for its Persil washing powder, took over a majority stake in Schwarzkopf from Hoechst AG last summer. Since then Schwarzkopf, boasting one of Germany's best selling shampoos, has helped Henkel boost its results considerably.
Henkel declined to reveal the purchase price for the stake. The family-owners of Schwarzkopf have swapped their shares for Henkel common shares.
Only two weeks ago Henkel scored a strategic coup when it acquired the remaining minority stake of U.S. adhesives group Loctite Corp. for about $1.3 billion, or $61 in cash per share.
Analysts said the acquisitions, last year's Schwarzkopf move and the Loctite deal, put Henkel in a much stronger position in terms of geography and products.
Henkel shares closed Frankfurt bourse trade up 60 pfennigs at 73.60 marks.
